value.rationale: The natural and fully classified family of all 2,048 binary order-five de Bruijn cycles has invariant short-factor frequencies yet varies in incremental LZ78 parse complexity with starting position and cyclic ordering. The exact 65,536-root distribution and all six possible per-cycle min/max types, including thirty rotation-invariant cycles, give a nontrivial finite benchmark of dictionary parsing on maximally diverse cyclic strings. The natural family/invariant motivates this finite cutoff independently of future larger-order theorems.
